author: WebBound
description: 优书网 (youshu.me) dataset — books, reviews and reviewers by book ID, for the yousuu database snapshot. Runs in the Datasets view; needs a youshu.me tab that has passed Cloudflare and is logged in (reviews require login). Params: from/to = book ID range; mode "update" keeps reviews at or after `since` (site time), "full" takes every review page; reviews:false = books only.
